name: Acceptable Use and Prohibited Conduct
text: You agree to use the Services only for lawful purposes and in compliance with these Terms and all applicable laws, including the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the rules made thereunder. You shall not: (a) upload, transmit, or share any content that is unlawful, defamatory, obscene, infringing, or that violates the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021; (b) impersonate any person or misrepresent your affiliation; (c) transmit any virus, malware, or harmful code; (d) attempt to gain unauthorised access to the Services, other accounts, or connected systems; (e) use the Services to send spam or unsolicited communications; or (f) engage in any activity that interferes with or disrupts the Services. The Company reserves the right to investigate and take appropriate action, including removal of content and suspension of access, against any User who violates this clause.

verification_flags.raised_by: Client review, September 2026 — 'Check whether the IT Intermediary Rules actually apply to LegalAId'.
verification_flags.question: Whether the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 apply to the party adopting this policy. An intermediary under section 2(1)(w) of the IT Act, 2000 receives, stores or transmits a record on behalf of another person; a service that generates content for its own users may fall outside that.
verification_flags.why_not_resolved_here: The answer depends on what the adopting party actually does, which is a fact about the business rather than a property of the clause. Citing the Rules where they do not apply asserts obligations the party does not have.
